verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question when comparing security scanners, since many ship as SaaS. The evidence pack shows no Trivy option for choosing where data is stored. The `--region us-east-1` flag in trivy-comm-15 picks which AWS region to scan, not where Trivy's data lives, and local caching of analysis results (trivy-docs-9) is a different feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
